title: Grisons barley soup with air-dried beef
steps: Rinse the barley in a sieve. Chop the carrots, celery, leek and cabbage and cut the dried beef and ham into thin strips.
Sweat the vegetables in the oil for 5 minutes, add the barley and stock and simmer covered for 40 minutes.
Add the beans, dried beef and ham and let them heat through for 5 minutes.
Stir in the cream, season and serve with chives.
